title: There Are 6 American Flags on the Moon. None Is Red, White and Blue

scenes.text: Six American flags stand on the Moon. None has any colour left.
Apollo astronauts planted one at each landing, 1969 to 1972. Ordinary nylon flags.
In 2012 the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter photographed every site. Five flags still cast shadows. They're standing.
The missing one is Apollo 11's. Buzz Aldrin watched it fall as the ascent engine's exhaust hit it at liftoff.
But nothing filters the sunlight up there. Decades of raw ultraviolet and brutal temperature swings bleach nylon.
So, scientists say, they stand bleached white. Six blank flags, still casting shadows.

description:
Six nylon flags were planted on the Moon by the Apollo landings; in 2012 the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter imaged shadows at five sites, showing the flags still standing. Apollo 11's was blown over by the ascent engine exhaust, as Buzz Aldrin reported.
Decades of unfiltered ultraviolet and extreme temperatures have, scientists say, bleached the flags white.
Should anyone go back and replace them?
